Possible intra-abdominal infection is present. -- The records show consultations with infectious disease, gastroenterology, and surgery, as well as a bleeding scan, but they do not contain a diagnosis of intra-abdominal infection. The consultations suggest investigation but do not directly state or confirm the presence of an infection.
